_comment: Semantic Layer builder settings. Copy to ~/.leanscale-gtm/semantic-layer.json, or just run /semantic-layer:setup.
_repo_path_help: Where the generated semantic layer repo is written. Relative to the directory you run from.
_first_metrics_help: The metrics generated in full on the first run. These three are the ones conversion rate and time in stage depend on.
_stage_transitions_system_stamped_help: Probed in setup. If false, cycle-time metrics are generated with an explicit caveat and measure from today forward.
_qualified_stage_help: The stage whose ENTRY means an opportunity is qualified. Cohort metrics use entry into this stage, never close date.
_bookings_amount_field_help: The one currency field that means bookings. Chosen in setup from the real field list on your Opportunity object.
